decision: Technically supported as a bounded source-level candidate: exact positional tuple schemas plus anchored lookaround-free marker patterns. Not yet validated on the actual emitted grammar or model output.
scope: One source-only feasibility question; no new runtime profile executed.

sources.finding: Pinned Ollama source selects llama.cpp b11901; GitHub tag metadata resolves to commit5320c87ff0d994845b44ce7976f10055ec697447.

Lines1712–1738 pass a format object to native json_schema; lines2452–2478 wrap it as response_format.json_schema.schema on the chat path. Lines1480–1540 describe a zero-evaluation/zero-generation native grammar query; it was not called.
Lines186–206 parse an items array into a fixed tuple, with items taking precedence over prefixItems. Lines209–220 preserve the string pattern. Do not rely on modern prefixItems plus items:false.

Lines944–954 emit one required grammar child per tuple position; lines965–982 use pattern before string length constraints. Lines414–655 implement anchored patterns, groups/alternation/classes/repetition/hex escapes; unsupported lookarounds or other syntax fall back to any string with a warning. No added minLength guarantee is credited when pattern is present.
Lines169–174 retain an explicit items-as-array tuple test. These upstream test sources were read, not executed.

Lines203–223 document silently skipped unsupported features, prefixItems limitations, anchored-pattern requirements and unsupported uniqueItems/contains/not. Exact source branches take precedence over assuming complete JSON Schema support.
Lines268–279 initialize or reject grammar; lines643–681 apply the grammar mask before sampling or resample an invalid candidate under it. This is decoding-time enforcement, not text repair.
Lines270–284 route supplied json_schema through json_schema_to_grammar.
Line1585 converts the supplied chat JSON schema to a grammar.

Line147 defaults LLAMA_LLGUIDANCE to OFF. Actual emitted grammar of the already verified binary must still be observed before any enforcement claim; source inspection does not substitute for that future gate.

proposed_single_change: Replace only the per-request translations item schema with fixed positional items-array string patterns derived from existing source-bound compact markers. Retain the complete source-spelling messages, model, sampling/context/output/resource settings and output guards.

proposed_pattern.ordinary_prose: Model-generated literal Unicode and JSON short escapes. No ordinary facts or names are supplied by the grammar.
proposed_pattern.exact_markers: Each alternative includes each source segment marker exactly once; gaps cannot introduce literal < or a Unicode escape that decodes to it.
proposed_pattern.order: Enumerate all permutations of distinct occurrence tags within each segment; never force source word order.
proposed_pattern.bounded_scope: Existing original-six only; at most3 markers per segment (at most6 alternatives), otherwise refuse. No chunking/cropping/fallback syntax.

required_before_generation: Freeze actual six schemas derived only from exact source marker sets; no names, genders, roles or reference answers in schema.

Obtain the exact native converter output for each schema under a separately authorized measured zero-generation phase. Reject unsupported-pattern warnings, generic-string fallback, absent positional rules or any unexpected grammar path.

Independently check emitted grammar with positive/negative strings: every allowed order, missing/duplicate/unknown/cross-entry tags, extra/missing entries, JSON quotes/backslashes/short escapes, hidden Unicode-escaped tags, truncation and repeated ordinary prose. A standard JSON validator or Python regex alone is not proof of this native converter.
Reconfirm full actual prompt/token/source/context binding and the unchanged resource caps before any separately authorized one-shot translation case.
Preserve unchanged raw marker/schema/source/metadata/script checks and independent full meaning review; no restoration of missing tags or name repair.
remaining_limits: Markers alone do not require meaningful surrounding prose, correct pronouns/roles, quantity/negation/condition preservation or completeness. A tag-only response or added ordinary name can still meet grammar and fail meaning.
No generic guarantee covers translated marker position within a segment; all permutations deliberately remain available.
Arbitrary many markers require factorial alternatives; the bounded original-six proposal refuses sources above3 markers per segment.

The proposed gap excludes raw < and all Unicode JSON escapes, while allowing literal Unicode and standard short escapes. Literal angle-bracket prose needs a separate source contract and is not silently transformed.
Canonical namespace-equivalent Unicode prefixes may still trigger the existing post-generation guard. The grammar does not replace that stricter normalization-aware rejection.
Pattern constraints take precedence over minLength in this converter; adding minLength would not establish prose content.
Unsupported regex constructs may weaken to unrestricted strings, so actual emitted grammar must be independently verified before generated output is trusted.
Decoding constraints can increase latency, cause length-limited output, or shift other errors; native memory/time/normal-stop/semantic gates remain unchanged.
web_search_open_disabled_fallback: Used read-only GitHub connector for official pinned source text; no checkout or native API calls.
